Class OffHeapLongObjectMapImpl<V>

java.lang.Object
express.mvp.roray.ffm.ds.map.OffHeapLongObjectMapImpl<V>
All Implemented Interfaces:
OffHeapLongObjectMap<V>, AutoCloseable
@Deprecated public class OffHeapLongObjectMapImpl<V> extends Object implements OffHeapLongObjectMap<V>
Deprecated.
A linear-probing, open-addressing hash map with off-heap keys and on-heap values.

Not thread-safe. Designed for single-threaded hot paths.

    • probeForPut

      protected final long probeForPut(long key)
      Returns a packed long where the sign bit indicates whether the key already exists.

      If found, result < 0 and (int) result is the existing index.

      If not found, result >= 0 and (int) result is an insertion slot.

      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the table is full
